decisions.reason: It has stayed visible on its own page since launch and fits the firm’s core natural facial-care offer, so its performance likely meets aspiration levels and gives a small established producer little reason to reallocate resources.

The serum remains on the website across two years and matches a strong market segment close to the firm’s capabilities, but its lower prominence than Product A suggests somewhat more uncertainty and a moderately higher risk if results only narrowly meet aspirations.

As a very recent launch in the core range, it is still in the learning phase and the firm is likely to keep it for now if no clear failure is visible, though limited slack in a small firm makes a newer product more vulnerable if early results disappoint.
